signal_logic.hold: Within band AND estimated return >= bucket minimum
signal_logic.watch_return: Within band BUT estimated return below bucket minimum (first time)
signal_logic.research_trigger: Within band BUT estimated return below bucket minimum 2+ consecutive months OR underperformed benchmark >3% over 12m AND below threshold
signal_logic.rebalancing_candidate: Outside band by > 2% — escalate to Step 10 Category 7

scaling_freeze.rule: sleeve must beat VUAG AND IWMO ex-MU over 4 consecutive months (A14 log); override unfreeze permitted at 3 via A13 entry
